effects: The signer sends msg.value SGB to the WSGB contract.
The signer receives the same amount of WSGB, minted to msg.sender.
The signer's vote power grows by that amount and follows their existing percentage delegations.
formats.shown: "Wrap SGB" with the SGB amount sent (@.value).

effects: The signer sends msg.value SGB to the WSGB contract.
The recipient, not the signer, gets the same amount of WSGB minted to it (WNat.depositTo: _mint(recipient, msg.value)).
formats.shown: "Wrap SGB" with the SGB amount and the recipient in a 'To' field.

findings.title: depositTo intent says "Wrap SGB", the same as deposit(), and does not say the WSGB goes to another address.
findings.evidence: WNat.sol depositTo: `_mint(recipient, msg.value);` Descriptor intent "Wrap SGB" is the same as for deposit(). The recipient appears only in the 'To' field.

effects: The signer's WSGB balance is burned by `amount`.
The signer receives `amount` SGB (msg.sender.transfer(amount)).
The burn reverts if explicitly delegated vote power is above the balance left (_burnVotePower requires _isTransmittable).
The signer spends `amount` of the allowance that `owner` gave the signer for WSGB.
`amount` of the owner's WSGB is burned.
The signer (msg.sender) receives `amount` SGB.
formats.shown: "Unwrap WSGB" with the owner and the WSGB amount.

findings.title: withdrawFrom intent does not say it uses the owner's allowance or that SGB goes to the signer.
findings.evidence: WNat.sol withdrawFrom: `_approve(owner, msg.sender, allowance(owner, msg.sender).sub(amount, ...)); _burn(owner, amount); msg.sender.transfer(amount);` The intent "Unwrap WSGB" is identical to withdraw().

effects: `amount` WSGB leaves the signer for `recipient`.
Vote power moves with the tokens, and the transfer reverts if the remaining balance cannot cover explicit delegations.
formats.shown: "Send WSGB" with the WSGB amount and the recipient.

findings.title: transfer recipient addressName types omit "wallet", which is narrower than the code allows.
findings.evidence: descriptor transfer 'To' params.types ["eoa","contract"], while depositTo uses ["eoa","wallet","contract"]. ERC20._transfer accepts any non-zero address.

effects: The allowance of `spender` over the signer's WSGB is set to `amount`. This replaces the old allowance and is not added to it.
formats.shown: "Approve WSGB" with the spender and the amount (Unlimited above 2^255).

effects: The signer's percentage delegation to `_to` is set to `_bips`/100 % of their WSGB vote power. This is not added to the old value, and 0 removes it.
The signer's delegation mode becomes PERCENTAGE for good, so explicit delegation is no longer possible.
No tokens move.
formats.shown: "Delegate FTSO vote power" with the provider and the share in % (0 revokes).

findings.title: delegate permanently fixes the account's delegation mode to percentage, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: VPContract/Delegatable _delegateByPercentage: `delegationModes[_from] = DelegationMode.PERCENTAGE;` VPToken.delegationModeOf doc: "Once the delegation mode is set, it never changes". Nothing in the descriptor mentions it.

effects: The signer's explicit delegation to `_to` is set to `_amount` WSGB of vote power. This replaces the old value, and 0 revokes.
The delegated amount can no longer be transferred or unwrapped until it is undelegated (_isTransmittable check).
The signer's delegation mode becomes AMOUNT for good, so percentage delegation and undelegateAll() are no longer possible.
formats.shown: "Delegate vote power, locks WSGB" with the provider and the WSGB amount (0 revokes).

findings.title: delegateExplicit permanently switches the account to explicit mode, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: _delegateByAmount: `delegationModes[_from] = DelegationMode.AMOUNT;` and _undelegateAllByPercentage requires PERCENTAGE mode. Intent "Delegate vote power, locks WSGB" covers the lock but not that the mode is permanent.

effects: Every percentage delegation of the signer is revoked, and all delegated vote power returns to the signer.
It reverts for accounts in explicit mode. No tokens move.
formats.shown: "Undelegate FTSO vote power" with no fields.

findings.title: undelegateAll intent does not say every delegation is revoked.
findings.evidence: _undelegateAllByPercentage iterates all delegates, undelegates each, and calls `delegation.clear()`. Descriptor intent "Undelegate FTSO vote power" is the same as undelegateAllExplicit, which only revokes the listed providers, and there are no fields.

effects: The signer's explicit delegations to each listed provider are set to 0, which unlocks that WSGB.
Delegations to providers not listed stay in place. It reverts in percentage mode. No tokens move.
formats.shown: "Undelegate FTSO vote power" with the list of providers.
